description: Administration, operation or support of executive and legislative organs. Includes office of the chief executive at all levels of government; legislative bodies at all levels of government; advisory, administrative and political staffs attached to chief executives and legislatures; libraries and other reference services serving these bodies.
includes: office of the chief executive (head of state, governor, mayor, etc.) at all levels of government
legislative bodies (parliament, assemblies, councils) at all levels of government
advisory, administrative and political staffs attached to executives and legislatures
permanent and temporary committees and commissions established by or acting on behalf of the executive or legislature
excludes: financial and fiscal affairs — ministries of finance, revenue authorities, tax administration and customs, see 0112

external affairs — ministries of foreign affairs, diplomatic missions, embassies and consulates abroad, and information and cultural services intended for distribution beyond national boundaries, see 0113
ministries handling specific functional areas (classified to the corresponding function)
